projects.name: PayFlow: digital banking and payments platform
projects.stack: Java 21, Spring Boot, Spring Security (JWT, OAuth2/Keycloak), PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Next.js + TypeScript, Docker, GitHub Actions, AWS
features: Customer onboarding, accounts, balances and statements
Money transfers through a double-entry ledger (every debit has a matching credit)
Idempotency keys so a retried request never moves money twice
Concurrency control: SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and optimistic locking
Transfer saga across services with the transactional outbox and Kafka
Audit log, rate limiting, PII masking, role-based access
Next.js dashboard with charts, optimistic transfers and E2E tests
80%+ test coverage with Testcontainers; CI/CD to AWS

projects.name: TradeDesk: real-time trading and portfolio system
projects.stack: Spring Boot microservices, Kafka Streams, WebSockets, Kubernetes, Helm, Argo CD, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenShift sandbox
features: Order-matching engine (limit and market orders, price-time priority)
Live price feed over WebSockets; portfolio and P&L service
Kafka Streams for real-time aggregates
Kubernetes deployment with Helm, HPA autoscaling and probes
Grafana dashboards; k6 load test with published numbers
GitOps deploys with Argo CD; also deployed to OpenShift sandbox

projects.name: FinAgent: agentic AI financial assistant
projects.stack: Spring AI and/or LangGraph (Python), pgvector, MCP server, React chat UI, Docker/Kubernetes
features: RAG over bank policy documents and a user's transaction history, with citations
Agents that call PayFlow APIs as tools (balance, spend analysis, transfers)
Human approval required before any money moves
MCP server exposing PayFlow tools to any MCP client
Guardrails against prompt injection; PII redaction
Eval suite (golden questions, LLM-as-judge) with scores in the README
Tracing with Langfuse; cost and latency dashboard

extras: Open-source PR merged (Java, Kubernetes or React component library)
